subject: MAP kickoff: Dedicated capacity, eval plan, and close tracker
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@atlasai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Dedicated capacity, eval plan, and close tracker

Hi Samantha — great to meet you last week on the call. Following our conversation, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on dedicated capacity, the evaluation plan, and a realistic close timeline. Attaching the working docs below.

Quick summary / asks:
- Goal: provision a dedicated GPU pool for AtlasAI production inference (initial target: 200 concurrent user requests, sustained 300 tokens/sec aggregate).
- Deliverables this sprint (owners in parentheses): MAP doc + timeline (me), evaluation test cases (AtlasAI + Rishi), capacity workbook with expected traffic profile (AtlasAI + Rishi).
- Target close date: 2026-09-10 (flexible if procurement needs more time).
- Immediate ask: please confirm the AtlasAI stakeholders who will own evaluation signoff, procurement, and security/compliance.

Attachments:
- MAP-dedicated-capacity-v1.docx (MAP outline, milestones, owner table)
- eval-plan-v1.md (test case matrix + pass/fail criteria)
- capacity-workbook.xlsx (traffic scenarios + GPU-sizing calculator)

Proposed next step: 30-minute MAP kickoff today or Monday to confirm owners and lock the eval dataset. I can host and share the screen.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

— Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@atlasai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasai.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Dedicated capacity, eval plan, and close tracker

Thanks, Priyom — this looks good. Confirming stakeholders from AtlasAI:
- Eval & ML signoff: Samantha Lee (me)
- Security/compliance: Jorge Mendez <jorge.m@atlasai.com> (cc'ed on procurement)
- Procurement / contracting: procurement@atlasai.com

A couple of notes from our side:
- The target close date of 2026-09-10 is fine but procurement may need two extra weeks depending on SOC2 evidence review.
- For eval data, we need the tests to include anonymized logs from our user search traffic (I can share a 24-hour sample).

I'm available for a kickoff at 11:30 PT today or Monday morning (9–11 PT).

Samantha
Director of ML, AtlasAI
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@atlasai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Dedicated capacity, eval plan, and close tracker

Hi all — quick technical clarifications that will affect the capacity workbook and timeline:
1) Throughput and latency targets — Priyom's note: 200 concurrent requests / 300 tokens/sec aggregate. Is the 300 tokens/sec target per-model or total across models? If AtlasAI expects multiple model families behind the same endpoint we should account for peak model fan-out.
2) Preferred instance types — for our sizing calc we recommend NVIDIA GH200 or L40S for low-latency RLHF-style models; if you want to optimize cost we can propose quantized A100 pools. Please confirm a preference.
3) KV cache reuse — if your workload has strong prefix reuse we can lower required GPUs by ~30% via KV caching and prefix coalescing. If you can provide a 24-hour sample, upload to the shared drive link and mark it as anon.

I've attached a lightweight capacity-specs.csv with fields I need filled (avg tokens/request, max seq length, expected top-K reranks). The CSV will feed the workbook and give us a recommended baseline GPU count.

I'll defer final sizing until I get the traffic sample. Happy to walk through numbers in the kickoff.

— Rishi
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@atlasai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Dedicated capacity, eval plan, and close tracker

Adding two operational items from CS/Onboarding: 
- Onboarding owner: Monica Patel (technical onboarding) and Lauren Bishop (customer success lead) — we'll coordinate runbooks and a one-week canary window post-provisioning.
- SLA expectations: for Dedicated customers we generally offer 99.9% uptime SLA in the contract. If AtlasAI needs a stricter SLO we should surface that now so sales/legal can scope it.

Operational checklist sample (to be added to MAP):
- Access setup & KMS key exchange (owner: AtlasAI security)
- Test harness deployment (owner: Redwood; Rishi)
- Canary traffic window and rollback plan (owner: Monica + AtlasAI eval lead)

If we proceed with a canary window, propose the window be at least 5 business days with automated quality checks tied to the eval-plan pass/fail matrix.

— Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Thanks for the fast responses — consolidating next steps below (updated MAP attached).

Owners & immediate deliverables:
- MAP doc (Priyom) — updated with the timeline below and owners table.
- Eval dataset (AtlasAI / Samantha) — upload anon 24-hour sample to the shared Drive by EOD Monday (2026-08-17).
- Capacity worksheet (Rishi) — Rishi will fill recommended GPU count after reviewing sample; target first-pass sizing by 2026-08-19.
- Security evidence pack (AtlasAI / Jorge) — procurement to confirm SOC2 items; Redwood legal to triage.
- Onboarding/canary plan (Monica + Lauren) — propose canary start 2026-08-24 if sizing is approved.

Proposed milestone timeline (dates are tentative):
- 2026-08-17: AtlasAI uploads eval sample
- 2026-08-19: Redwood sizing recommendation & cost estimate
- 2026-08-24: Provisioning + Canary start (5 business days)
- 2026-09-01: Canary review & quality signoff
- 2026-09-10: Contract target close

Meeting: scheduling 30-min kickoff. Samantha mentioned 11:30 PT today — I will book 11:30–12:00 PT and send an invite. If procurement needs a different attendee list please let us know.

Attachments (updated): MAP-dedicated-capacity-v1.docx, eval-plan-v1.md, capacity-workbook.xlsx
